title: Garlic Butter Focaccia

steps.title: Mix the dough
steps.content: Whisk {0001}, {0003} and {0004}, then pour in {0002} and mix to a shaggy dough.

steps.title: Bulk proof
steps.content: Cover and leave at room temperature until doubled.

steps.title: Make the garlic butter
steps.content: Melt {0006} with finely sliced {0005} over low heat.

steps.title: Bake
steps.content: Dimple the dough, pour over the garlic butter, scatter {0007} and bake at 220C.

notes: A slow-proofed focaccia with a garlic butter crust. The long cold rest is what gives it the open crumb — the dough can sit overnight in the fridge instead of the 2h bulk proof, and is easier to dimple cold.
